executive_summary: Maven test compilation failed with 100 errors across 3 test classes. Primary issues: (1) Type mismatches between Priority and TaskPriority enums, (2) Service method signatures requiring additional userId/username parameters not provided by tests, (3) Type conversions between long/UUID/String types, (4) Missing methods in GlobalExceptionHandler and InMemoryTaskDataStore classes.

errors.message: Priority enum cannot be converted to TaskPriority enum
errors.root_cause: Test code uses Priority enum but the application expects TaskPriority enum. This indicates a mismatch between DTO definitions and test expectations.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update TaskCreateRequest and TaskUpdateRequest DTOs to use Priority enum instead of TaskPriority, or update all test cases to use TaskPriority.HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW instead of Priority.HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW.

errors.message: long cannot be converted to UUID
errors.root_cause: TaskResponse constructor expects UUID for task ID but tests are passing long values. The domain model was changed to use UUID but tests were not updated.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update TaskResponse to accept UUID instead of long for the id field. Update all test cases to use UUID.randomUUID() or UUID.fromString() instead of numeric long values.

errors.message: createTask method requires userId parameter but test provides only TaskCreateRequest
errors.root_cause: TaskService.createTask signature was changed to require (String userId, TaskCreateRequest request) but tests still call it with only (TaskCreateRequest request).
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all TaskService.createTask() mock calls in tests to include userId as first parameter: when(taskService.createTask(eq(
), any(TaskCreateRequest.class))).

errors.message: getUserTasks method signature mismatch - requires 4 parameters but test provides 3
errors.root_cause: TaskService.getUserTasks now requires (String userId, int page, int size, String sortBy) but tests call it with (long userId, int page, int size). Missing sortBy parameter and wrong userId type.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all getUserTasks mock calls to: when(taskService.getUserTasks(eq(
))). Change userId from long to String.

errors.message: getTaskById method requires UUID and userId but test provides only long
errors.root_cause: TaskService.getTaskById signature changed to (UUID taskId, String userId) but tests call it with only (long taskId).
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all getTaskById calls to: when(taskService.getTaskById(any(UUID.class), eq(
))). Convert long IDs to UUID in test setup.

errors.message: updateTask method requires UUID, userId, and TaskUpdateRequest but test provides long and TaskUpdateRequest
errors.root_cause: TaskService.updateTask signature changed to (UUID taskId, String userId, TaskUpdateRequest request) but tests use (long taskId, TaskUpdateRequest request).
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all updateTask calls to: when(taskService.updateTask(any(UUID.class), eq(
), any(TaskUpdateRequest.class))). Convert task IDs to UUID.

errors.message: deleteTask method requires UUID and userId but test provides only long
errors.root_cause: TaskService.deleteTask signature changed to (UUID taskId, String userId) but tests call it with only (long taskId).
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all deleteTask calls to: doNothing().when(taskService).deleteTask(any(UUID.class), eq(
)). Convert task IDs to UUID.

errors.message: bulkCreateTasks method requires userId and List but test provides only List
errors.root_cause: TaskService.bulkCreateTasks signature changed to (String userId, List<TaskCreateRequest> requests) but tests call it with only (List<TaskCreateRequest> requests).
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all bulkCreateTasks calls to: when(taskService.bulkCreateTasks(eq(
), anyList())). Add userId as first parameter.

errors.message: Method handleValidationErrors not found in GlobalExceptionHandler
errors.root_cause: Test expects handleValidationErrors method but GlobalExceptionHandler does not define this method. Either the method was removed or renamed.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add handleValidationErrors method to GlobalExceptionHandler: @ExceptionHandler(MethodArgumentNotValidException.class) public ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> handleValidationErrors(MethodArgumentNotValidException ex).

errors.message: Type mismatches in InMemoryTaskDataStore - userId should be String not long, Priority vs TaskPriority enum
errors.root_cause: InMemoryTaskDataStore expects String userId and TaskPriority enum but tests use long userId and Priority enum.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update InMemoryTaskDataStore to accept String userId instead of long. Align Priority/TaskPriority enum usage across DTOs and domain models.

errors.message: findByUserId method signature mismatch - requires 4 parameters but test provides 3
errors.root_cause: InMemoryTaskDataStore.findByUserId now requires (String userId, int page, int size, String sortBy) but tests call it with (long userId, int page, int size).
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all findByUserId calls to: dataStore.findByUserId(
). Change userId from long to String and add sortBy parameter.

errors.message: Methods findAll and existsById not found in InMemoryTaskDataStore
errors.root_cause: Tests call findAll() and existsById() methods that do not exist in InMemoryTaskDataStore class.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add findAll() method returning List<Task> and existsById(UUID id) method returning boolean to InMemoryTaskDataStore class.

summary: 12 grouped compilation error categories found affecting 100 individual error instances
